fato_historico: 1939: World War II: General Władysław Sikorski becomes prime minister of the Polish government-in-exile.
energia_do_dia: The stars invite you to seek harmony in all interactions, Libra. Much like the resilience of those who lead from afar to preserve hope, your spirit may find strength in diplomacy today. It is a good time to consider building bridges and restoring balance where things felt fractured. Your grace remains your greatest asset as you navigate these gentle transitions.
frase_do_dia: True balance is found when you honor your heart and the needs of others.
significado_numero: A master number representing the manifestation of your most peaceful dreams.
conselho: Choose words that heal and actions that foster lasting peace within your circle.
